definitions.short: to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire
definitions.full: H2846. chathah [ חָתָה ] verb snatch up , usually fire, coals (Late Hebrew id. ; חֲתָא ᵑ7 , id. (rare); Assyrian —atû is destroy (i.e. snatch away ? ) see SASm Asrb i. 90 ) — Qal Imperfect יַחְתֶּה Prov 6:27 ; suffix יַחְתְּךָ Psa 52:7 ; Infinitive construct לַחְתּוֺת Isa 30:14 ; Participle חֹתֶה Prov 25:22 ; — snatch up , with accusative מִיָּקוּד אֵשׁ Isa 30:14 to snatch up fire from a hearth (|| מִגֶּבֶא מים לַחְשׂף ); בְּחֵיקוֺ אֵשׁ Prov 6:27 shall a man snatch up fire in his bosom and his garments not be burned ? (in simile of adulterer); pregnantly seize (and put) upon ח אַתָּה ׳גְּחָלִים עלרֿאֹשׁוֺ 25:22 ; מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְיִסָּֽחֲךָ יַחְתְּךָ Psa 52:7 God . . . shall snatch thee away , and pluck thee up tent-less.
